summary: Updates RFC 7296 so IKEv2 can use raw public keys of types other than RSA, such as elliptic curve keys. This is useful in constrained environments.

eli5.summary: Before, only one kind of ID card was accepted. Now more kinds are, including smaller ones that suit tiny devices.

questions: does ikev2 support raw public keys
how to use elliptic curve raw public keys in ikev2
